name: pixelwright
description: Pixel art for AI agents, made and animated in code and proved by gates. Make: an AI render, PixelLab output or drawing becomes real pixel art (true-grid snap, background cleared, palette locked to PICO-8, a file or the set's own sprites, binary alpha, stray pixels, outlines, crop to engine size, seamless tiles). Animate: an existing still moves inside region masks (glows, sparks, parts, construction) with the rest frame equal to the still and nothing outside the mask changed, packed as sheets with previews and a click-to-pick review page. One Python CLI (pxw.py, numpy and Pillow). Formerly spritewright.
